purpose: Qualify the paired same-order-beyond-geography transfer increment on the response-blind 250-species development geometry before any confirmatory-panel nucleotide identity can be opened.

frozen_estimator.estimand: species-equal mean of [C_same_order_geo - C_geo] over the response-blind same-order-supported evaluation set
frozen_estimator.inference: one-sided centered studentized held-out-species bootstrap of paired target increments

positive_control.group_rule: exact frozen phylogatR order shared within order, independent across orders

qualification.type1_gate: for every private-null cell, Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate must be <=0.10
qualification.power_gate: same_order_A2 Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate must be >=0.80
qualification.overall_pass: all four private Type-I cells pass AND same_order_A2 power passes
qualification.failure: NOT_EVALUABLE_CONDITIONAL_ORDER; do not open confirmatory nucleotide identity

execution.sharding_semantics: absolute replicate index only; shard/batch partition must not alter world or bootstrap identity
execution.cached_and_uncached_scorers_must_match: to absolute tolerance 1e-12 on fixed test fixtures

forbidden_after_freeze: changing support radius, target-coverage threshold, minimum source count, field bandwidth, alpha or bootstrap resamples
dropping response-blind supported targets based on synthetic or empirical scores
changing private amplitudes or positive-control amplitude after qualification outcomes
opening confirmatory-panel nucleotide identity before qualification PASS and confirmatory exact-geometry requalification
using the completed parent 211-species outcomes to tune this qualification
